thread:
alex: CI red on PR #4821 — snapshot failures in `prompt-render-test`. Looks like a tiny serialization/output drift. Pasting the failing excerpt below.

alex: ```
- "The user said: "Hello""
+ "The user said: "Hello" ​"
```

alex: Not sure if this is kv-cache prefix change or the protobuf -> json encoder tweak from earlier this week.

maria: Huh, that looks like a zero-width space (ZWSP) at the end. I remember a normalization tweak in my prefix-hash PR (#4809) but it shouldn't add characters.

ryan: Can we rerun just that test on the failing commit? `./ci_tools/retry_test --test prompt-render-test --commit abc123`

ci-bot: Re-run requested by ryan: queued job 5692.

sasha: If it's intermittant, try this locally: `scripts/repro_snapshot.sh abc123 prompt-render-test` or run a quick loop: `for i in {1..10}; do python -m redwood.tests.render_prompt --commit abc123; done` — that catches flakes.

alex: Good call. I'll run 10 iterations now. If it's ZWSP maybe serializer sometimes appends it when trimming prefixes.

maria: Also check whether the change touched `prefix_hash.normalization` — I added an edge case to preserve trailing byte sequences which could explain intermittent ZWSPs.

ryan: I did touch prefix handling but only for hashing; no deliberate extra chars. I'll replicate alex's loop and revert my local change to see if it stops.

ci-bot: Re-run job 5692 completed: rerun-2 passed, but original build remains red (1/3 flaky detection).

alex: rerun-2 passed locally for me too, but my 10-iter loop showed 2/10 with ZWSP. That's flaky enough to avoid a golden update.

sasha: Agreed — don't update goldens yet. Short-term: add comparator tolerance to strip trailing ZWSPs in the snapshot comparator to avoid noise. Long-term: fix serializer determinism.

alex: I'll open INF ticket and a small PR to strip ZWSP in comparator: INF-729. Notes: include repro steps and the sample diff above.

ryan: I'll add extra logging around `serialize_prompt()` so we can capture bytes that lead to ZWSP. If it's prefix trimming edge-case, log the raw prefix bytes.

maria: Also saw CI flaky rate jump on main after the prefix-hash push earlier today — CI metrics show ~1.3% flaky bump. I'll follow up with infra to see correlated jobs.

alex: Plan summary: 1) temporary comparator tolerance PR (alex) 2) logging + bisect from ryan to find offending commit 3) INF ticket + triage (maria) 4) don't update goldens until deterministic fix confirmed.

sasha: Sounds good. If anyone finds a minimal repro commit-range ping here and @eng-ml-oncall.

alex: Filing comparator PR now and INF-729 opened. Will post links shortly. :thumbsup:
